newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Incontra denies deals on Guemassa zinc.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Incontra denies deals on Guemassa zinc.

text.p: Swiss Incontra AG, world-wide sales agent for Compagnie Minieres des Guemassa of Casablanca, denied that negotiations for this year's output of zinc concentrate had taken place with Italy's Enirisorse, nor were any deals concluded.

"Incontra...confirms that no negotiations for Guemassa Zinc concentrates for 1997 have yet taken place between Enirisorse and Guemassa/Incontra and that no deals have been concluded for this year's zinc concentrate shipments," Markus Hofmann, Incontra's executive vice president said in a statement.
Earlier this month European zinc industry sources had said that Guemassa appeared to have concluded deals to sell zinc concentrates to Enirisorse and another continental smelter.
Enirisorse has also denied the deal.
